articles.title: What If Alexander the Great Had Not Died at 32?
articles.description: What if the fever in Babylon had broken — and Alexander had turned west? A decade-by-decade journey through a world that might have been.

articles.title: What If the Library of Alexandria Was Never Destroyed?
articles.description: What if ancient knowledge had survived, launching the industrial revolution a thousand years early and changing the course of civilization?

articles.title: What If the Aztecs Had Discovered Europe?
articles.description: What if the Aztec Empire had crossed the Atlantic and reached Lisbon? Explore an alternate Age of Discovery in which Tenochtitlan's fleets connected the Americas and Europe.

articles.title: What If the Cuban Missile Crisis Had Gone Hot?
articles.description: What if the negotiations had failed in October 1962 — and the Northern Hemisphere had destroyed itself? A journey through a world where the Global South inherited the Earth.

articles.title: What If the Umayyads Had Conquered Europe?

articles.title: What If Napoleon Had Won in Egypt?
articles.description: What if Napoleon's Egyptian campaign had ended in victory — and France had established a permanent foothold in the Eastern Mediterranean?

articles.title: What If Rome Had Never Fallen?
articles.description: What if the Western Roman Empire had survived the fifth century — and Rome had never fallen? A journey through an alternate Europe, where the Middle Ages never took the form we know.

articles.title: What If the Spanish Armada Had Landed?
articles.description: What if the winds had turned — and the Spanish Armada had landed its army on English soil? A journey through a world where the Reformation was rolled back and the British Empire never rose.

articles.title: What If the Ottomans Had Taken Vienna?
articles.description: What if Kara Mustafa had stormed the city in 1683 — and the Ottoman Empire had pushed into the heart of Europe? A journey through a continent that might have been.

articles.title: What If Napoleon Had Won at Waterloo?
articles.description: What if Grouchy's corps had broken the Allied flank — and Napoleon had remained master of Europe? A journey through a continent trapped in an empire that never ended.

articles.title: What If the Asteroid Had Missed the Earth?
articles.description: What if the dinosaurs had never gone extinct? Explore an alternate world of evolving dinosaurs, a different fate for mammals, and the possibility that humanity might never have existed.

articles.title: What If Mars Never Lost Its Ancient Oceans?
articles.description: What if our closest planetary neighbor stayed blue and lush? Explore the space race for a living world next door — and what it would mean for humanity.

articles.title: What If the World Wide Web Had Never Been Invented?
articles.description: What if the Web had never existed? Explore a world without instant connection — and what it would mean for society, knowledge, and human progress.
